title: Excitability in quantum field theory
summary: In quantum field theory, it is not always possible to excite one state out of another using only local operators. This paper establishes abstract algebraic criteria for (local) excitability in general quantum theories, and computes these criteria explicitly for zero-mean Gaussian states in (generalized) free field theories. We find that in this context, due to the special nature of Gaussian states, one-way excitability always implies two-way excitability, and our results generalize the "quasiequivalence theorems" of Powers, Stormer, van Daele, Araki, and Yamagami.
